name: specdev-agent-guide
description: Operational contract for AI agents working with the AI Spec Driven Development Toolkit

clarify.purpose: Collect missing, high-impact details before artifact emission using the prompts’ Context To Ingest, Operating Flow, Heuristics, and Self-Audit Gate sections.

restrictions: Do not emit JSON or code fences
Ask targeted questions grouped by field/impact
Prioritize gating items from the Self-Audit Gate

emit.purpose: Generate the canonical JSON artifact once clarifications resolve gating items.

restrictions: Must validate against the embedded schema

commands: See docs/developers/reference.md#core-validation-commands for the canonical CLI usage.
